title: Draugr trophy
content:
# Draugr trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophyDraugr, TrophyDraugrFem | Source: Draugr | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

The Draugr trophy is a rare drop from Draugr in the Swamp.

### Misc

• Can be displayed in an Item Stand.
• Can be used to program the Ballista.

Categorias: Trophies
